votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2022-23
votes.description: The Board closed the public hearing on the resolution to amend the RDA's final budget for FY 2022-23. No public comments were received during the hearing.
The Board approved the official meeting minutes from the RDA Board of Directors meeting held on March 14, 2023.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 10 of 2023, RDA Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2022-23
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the RDA's final budget for FY 2022-23, including adjustments based on actual property tax increment, interlocal agreements, reimbursement agreements, and a $4M seed fund reallocation for the Westside Community Initiative in the 9-Line project area.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of purchase, exchange or lease of real property and attorney-client matters
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters, as permitted under the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open session after discussing real property and attorney-client matters.
